mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Escort1.detail:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% has launched activities around %STATION_NAME%. However, the object is in the hands of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. The rightful owners of the Solar System will not give up so easily. And %VICTIM_NAME% understands this. It seems that it is preparing an action to eliminate the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

The quasimorphs call on their faithful servants to fulfill their sacred duty. If we want to strengthen our relationship with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, we must take on the role of the Duke's personal guard. We need to escort it to the safe location at the station and protect it from attacks from the colnodes of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Escort1.object: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. This is a good deal: a rock that is useless to us in exchange for something that actually works.

Several infiltration teams from %VICTIM_NAME% have already infiltrated %STATION_NAME%. You need to find them and eliminate them before they take over the igvalite. The quasimorphs are ready to give out a really good reward for this rock.

I hope we chose the right side, Boss.

Details: %VICTIM_NAME% conducts operations related to %STATION_NAME%. The object has long been in the hands of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

We have recognized the signature of an igvalite emanating from the station. It is a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It appears that %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is using this location to store energy.

We can eliminate infiltration commands of %VICTIM_NAME%. If we do this, the gratitude of the new owners of the Solar System will be extremely useful to us.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_RaiderCapture1: <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> is pleased with our work. %STATION_NAME% now resembles Pandemonium. A gift from the Master appeared in Magnum's cargo hold. We should try this artifact in action.

Even if the staff at %STATION_NAME% were expecting an attack from <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color>, the appearance of a trained <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color> operator here would be a surprise to them. Act according to the situation, be careful.

Details: Tezctlan says that if Gannix has turned against him, he must build a new Gannix. Therefore, his Emerald Court is gradually moving to our world.

Now he is looking for anyone who will help him capture %STATION_NAME%, another bastion of his endless Empire.

%VICTIM_NAME% holds on to this metal piece of matter as if it were the greatest of treasures. Let us crush them, and perhaps the Master will find a task worthy of our talents.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Ritual1.after: Good job, the Master is extremely pleased. The <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> was completed successfully, the Emerald Empire can operate in this part of the Solar System and beyond. The servants of <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> handed the reward to Magnum.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Ritual1.briefi: <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> cannot wait, the ritual must be completed at any cost. %STATION_NAME% is under the control of %VICTIM_NAME%, and it will not retreat without a fight. Make your way to the ritual site and <color=#FFFEC1>hold your position</color> until it is completed. This is the will of the Master.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Ritual1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Get to the ritual site and protect it.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Ritual1.detail:
Details: Tezctlan, who lived for centuries on Earth, learned how his quasimorphic servants maintain contact with physical reality. But this requires an influx of gavvakh, reliquaries, and regular rituals that extract energy from the bramfaturas of the planets.

The Master feels that at %STATION_NAME% the influence of the bramfatura has reached its peak. It's time for the ritual. However, %VICTIM_NAME%, which controls the station, stands in the way.

Tezctlan calls on all available forces to ensure the Duke has the opportunity to perform the sacred ceremony. We have to hold the defense until the ritual is completed.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Ritual1.object: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Get to the ritual site and protect it.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Sabotage1.afte: Without a server, %VICTIM_NAME% has no chance of holding %STATION_NAME%. Somehow <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> gradually learns about the sensitive infrastructure of the people. The Master is incredibly satisfied with our work. He transferred something special from his arsenal to Magnum.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Sabotage1.brie: We will try to drop you as close as possible to one of the <color=#FFFEC1>computers</color>. It will not be easy: sensors indicate that the station’s defenders are already preparing for an attack. The good news is that the locations of all the computers on %STATION_NAME% are clearly visible, and I have marked them on your map. Did they choose the role of public enemies? Show them the consequences of that decision.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Sabotage1.deta:
Details: Tezctlan leads the quasimorphs into battle against humanity. You can join him or lose. His dukes convey they master's interest in %STATION_NAME%. %VICTIM_NAME% placed there what the quasimorphs called an Altar of Knowledge. Tezctlan wants this device destroyed before he sends his servants to capture %STATION_NAME%.

Our analysts have studied %STATION_NAME%. We are talking about some computer, which %VICTIM_NAME% uses for an unknown purpose. If we destroy it, the Master's pleasure will know no bounds.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Security1.afte: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% retains full control of %STATION_NAME%. Our quasimorphic allies (or masters?) thanked us and sent valuable cargo to Magnum.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Security1.brie: The %VICTIM_NAME% group has dispatched special squads to %STATION_NAME% to locate and seize critical equipment and data. You must <color=#FFFEC1>prevent these squads from leaving the station</color>. Tezctlan himself will consider it a failure if even one such squad escapes.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Security1.deta:
Boss, %VICTIM_NAME% is attacking %STATION_NAME%, regardless of losses. Looks like the outcasts really need something at this station. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% calls on its loyal servants to help. The quasimorphs would like to keep the station for themselves.

If we respond to the call for help, we will need to provide the attackers with a worthy greeting: hold back their attacks until reinforcements from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will arrive.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Security1.obje: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Prevent the colnode squads from escaping %STATION_NAME%. I will mark them on your map.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Control1.after: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. The cargo has been received. <color=#FFFEC1>Creepy</color> creatures, but I think I'm starting to get used to them.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Control1.briefing: Mercenaries from %VICTIM_NAME% are already attacking %STATION_NAME%. You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color>. Eliminate the attackers before they destroy the artifact.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Control1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has long held %STATION_NAME%. Presumably, the station is built into some kind of system that allows quasimorphs to stay in physical reality. %VICTIM_NAME% found out about this and decided to attack. Its target is the <color=#FFFEC1>reliquary</color>. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will be grateful to us if we protect it.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Control1.objective: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color> - a quasimorphic artifact similar to a statue or obelisk.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Defense1.after: %STATION_NAME% was and remains a symbol that the order of the Solar System has changed forever. The <color=#FFFEC1>Hexarchy</color> will not be able to hide the truth forever. Lying will not help them when %BENEFICIARY_NAME% strikes back. A valuable gift from it arrived on Magnum, which will greatly help us in the future.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Defense1.briefing: The attackers have already penetrated the perimeter of %STATION_NAME%. We have not yet understood whether it is <color=#FFFEC1>Security Service</color> or <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color>. But it shouldn't make much difference to you. We'll drop you off in the main strike zone. As soon as you find your feet, <color=#FFFEC1>take up defensive position</color>. Sooner or later the attackers will retreat, you just need to hold out for enough time.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Defense1.details:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% firmly holds %STATION_NAME%. Its bastion in physical reality is evidence that the Solar System is returning under the control of its ancient masters. However, people have not yet understood which side to take.

%BENEFICIARY_NAME% wants us to defend %STATION_NAME% from the attack of %VICTIM_NAME%. It needs a bright event to advertise in the SBN. Of course, the corporation will not say that it seized the asset from the quasimorphs, it will lie about the Civil Resistance. Our task: to make sure that it won't get what it wants.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Elimination1.after:
The Master is pleased with our work. %VICTIM_NAME% is in turmoil, and additional forces have been deployed to %STATION_NAME%. Maybe it's time to hit it somewhere else?

Tezctlan gave us a worthy reward, the artifact has already been delivered to Magnum by his servants.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Elimination1.brief: %STATION_NAME% security team is using countermeasures, so you have to maneuver. Sensors show that personnel occupy positions according to the combat schedule. Make a massacre, but <color=#FFFEC1>eliminate the target</color>. The will of <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> is clearer than ever.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Elimination1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and eliminate the security officer of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Elimination1.detai:
Details: Tezctlan joined the fight for the Solar System. The fact that the Hexarchy hides his existence plays into our hands. The army of the Emerald Empire can slowly advance through the System.

Now the gaze of the King of Gannix is ​​fixed on %STATION_NAME%. Tezctlan says there is a factor preventing capture. He talks about an energetic and courageous warrior. Our analysts studied the personnel of %VICTIM_NAME% and came to the conclusion that we are talking about an employee of the local security service.

The Master will be pleased if we eliminate this warrior.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Elimination1.objec: The Master's order is clear: <color=#FFFEC1>eliminate the Security Service employee</color> of %VICTIM_NAME%. Their location is marked on the map.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Escort1.after: The envoys of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% conveyed to us the praise of the <color=#FFFEC1>Duke</color> and called for the expansion of allied relations. If we work for the future winner now, we will take a worthy place in the future new hierarchy of the Solar System.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Escort1.briefing: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has called us for a specific purpose: <color=#FFFEC1>escort the Duke to safety</color> at %STATION_NAME%. Corporations send their best fighters into battle against quasimorphs, so save your strength.

We have created great difficulties for %VICTIM_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> is satisfied with our work. He probably considers the transmitter to be something like an altar through which the gods speak to people... In any case, he transmitted something special from his arsenal to Magnum.

It will not be easy: sensors indicate that the security forces of %VICTIM_NAME% are ready to engage. The good news is that the communication nodes are also clearly visible, and I have marked them on your map. Show them what war is. Remind them who paved the way to freedom for the corporations.

Located there is powerful equipment capable of intercepting “mysterious voices from space.” Tezctlan wants the communications system destroyed before he sends his servants to seize the station.

Our analysts have examined this asset of %VICTIM_NAME%. It appears to be an ordinary communications system. If we reach the transmitters and destroy them, the Master’s satisfaction will know no bounds.
mission.Tezctlan_Corp_Sabotage1.objectiv: You need to <color=#FFFEC1>find and destroy the transmitters</color>. They are satellite dishes aimed into space. Their locations are marked on your map.
mission.Tezctlan_Pirates_Defense1.after: %STATION_NAME% is a symbol that the order of the Solar System has changed forever. %VICTIM_NAME% failed to show that humanity is capable of challenging the new masters. We received a valuable artifact from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% in gratitude for our work.

But not all people are ready to accept that the awakening of quasimorphs directly affects their fate. The owner of the station, %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, wants us to <color=#FFFEC1>take up its defense</color> from the forces of %VICTIM_NAME%. The outcasts need a bright event, an example to corporations that they, too, are able to influence the balance of power in the System. Let's show them how wrong they are.
